description.value:
Traits Paradise-Touched

The secret flat check the GM rolls after a successful Static effect is DC 3 for you instead of DC 5. It is never removed and never becomes automatic: the GM still rolls it, still rolls it every single time, and still never confirms the result. A natural 1 on that check still fails, so a false answer always remains possible.

cinderfall.incomplete: The secret flat check DC is 3 instead of 5 for you. A real DC number change to a mechanic that lives entirely off the character sheet, in the GM's own secret roll. The class's Signal/Static core mechanic has no rule-element analog anywhere in pf2e-source: `AdjustDegreeOfSuccess` evaluates in `beforePrepareData`, before the roll resolves, so it cannot hook a GM's own secret post-roll check or show the player a value other than what was actually computed (`pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/adjust-degree-of-success.ts`); self-inflicted reactive damage/resource cost keyed to the resolving effect's own degree of success has no rule-element home; and no `Reroll` rule-element key exists anywhere in the compendium (`pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/ancestry/human/level-1/courteous-comeback.json` ships `rules: []`).
